fact: The General Information Authority announced the Tripoli government's Attaat tendering and procurement website is operational, with entities publishing tenders through it.
GIA statistics for July 2025: 189 government entities published tenders, 626 bids were announced and 840 entities were registered on Attaat.
The General Information Authority head announced the updated government tenders and procurement platform had started operating.
The General Information Authority says 189 government entities published tenders through the Attaat platform, the official platform for managing government tenders and purchases, in July 2025.
The General Information Authority reports 626 tenders were announced on the Attaat platform during July 2025.
